whole_sidecar_absence: A null tokenizer_config in each case means the file does not exist, not a JSON null file. Exact presence was verified and recorded by the native harness.
literal_paths: Every case records input_paths.windows and input_paths.linux. Reference reports also record the literal path supplied to native APIs.

confirmed.missing_sidecar_direct: Inferred Qwen2/Qwen3, GPT2, and generic fast classes set false; Llama fast preserves the saved value.
confirmed.single_and_nested_sequences: Child prefix remains unchanged for absent/false/true/null sidecar prefix settings and missing entire sidecar.

execution: Windows durable job plus GNU Linux durable host job retaining foreground wsl.exe; no detached processes or WSL lifecycle changes.
qualifications: Tokenizer preparation only, four string inputs; no full model conversion, remote auto_map execution, or slow reconstruction claim.
